resources.string: Use manual system Phone control for this session

The system refused call-management access. Keep the system Phone UI and explicitly choose manual answering, AI control or handback after granting the required permissions. This session-only fallback does not enable auto-answer or mark companion access ready.
Compatibility mode: tap the floating button for this call. Automatic answering is unavailable.
Answer a ringing call from the floating button
Allowed. Each ringing call still requires your tap.
Tap to allow answering calls. This is optional: without it, answer in the system Phone app first, then choose AI control.
Open system accessibility settings and choose whether to enable Mika. Required to show the control and read back the current call and mute state.
Manual control selected for this session. Check permissions and audio readiness.
